# NL8xxx\: portability warnings

The 12 codes of band 8. [Diagnostics](../diagnostics.md) says what a code promises and how a rule's fragment is matched.

## NL8001

The message of a warning `--warn-portability` turns on contains:

```text
…counts UTF-8 bytes here, and UTF-16 units in TypeScript…
```

[`nl8001_utf8_offset.ts`](https://github.com/amritk/nish/blob/main/tests/wordings/nl8001_utf8_offset.ts):

```ts
// NL8001: a UTF-8 byte count returned as `main`'s exit code, which TypeScript
// counts in UTF-16 units.
export const main = (): number => {
  const name = "héllo";
  return name.length;
};
```

```text
`name.length` counts UTF-8 bytes here, and UTF-16 units in TypeScript, and `main` returns it as the exit code
```

## NL8002

The message of a warning `--warn-portability` turns on contains:

```text
…panics here outside its receiver's bounds, where TypeScript clamps…
```

[`nl8002_slice_unproven.ts`](https://github.com/amritk/nish/blob/main/tests/wordings/nl8002_slice_unproven.ts):

```ts
// NL8002: a `slice` bound nothing proves inside the string, which panics here
// where TypeScript clamps it.
export const main = (): number => {
  const s = "abcdef";
  const at = s.length + 1;
  console.log(s.slice(0, at));
  return 0;
};
```

```text
`s.slice(0, at)` panics here outside its receiver's bounds, where TypeScript clamps: `at` is not proven inside `[0, length]`, and `substring` clamps in both
```

## NL8003

The message of a warning `--warn-portability` turns on contains:

```text
…is copied into the array here, and TypeScript stores the same object…
```

[`nl8003_record_copy.ts`](https://github.com/amritk/nish/blob/main/tests/wordings/nl8003_record_copy.ts):

```ts
// NL8003: a record pushed into an array, then written, then read through the array.
interface Point {
  x: i32;
  y: i32;
}

export const main = (): number => {
  const ps: Point[] = [];
  const p: Point = { x: 1, y: 2 };
  ps.push(p);
  p.x = 9;
  return ps[0].x;
};
```

```text
`p` is copied into the array here, and TypeScript stores the same object, so the later write `p.x = 9` (line 11) is not seen through `ps`
```

## NL8004

The message of a warning `--warn-portability` turns on contains:

```text
…overwrites the element a reference still reads, and TypeScript replaces the object instead…
```

[`nl8004_slot_store.ts`](https://github.com/amritk/nish/blob/main/tests/wordings/nl8004_slot_store.ts):

```ts
// NL8004: a store over a slot an element reference still reads.
interface Point {
  x: i32;
  y: i32;
}

export const main = (): number => {
  const ps: Point[] = [{ x: 1, y: 2 }];
  const r = ps[0];
  ps[0] = { x: 3, y: 4 };
  return r.x;
};
```

```text
`ps[0] = { x: 3, y: 4 }` overwrites the element a reference still reads, and TypeScript replaces the object instead (`r`, line 11)
```

## NL8005

The message of a warning `--warn-portability` turns on contains:

```text
…is filled with zeros here, and with holes in TypeScript…
```

[`nl8005_zero_fill.ts`](https://github.com/amritk/nish/blob/main/tests/wordings/nl8005_zero_fill.ts):

```ts
// NL8005: a zero-filled `new Array<f64>(n)`, which TypeScript fills with holes.
export const main = (): number => {
  const n = 4;
  const xs = new Array<f64>(n);
  return xs.length;
};
```

```text
`new Array<f64>(n)` is filled with zeros here, and with holes in TypeScript, which read back as `undefined`
```

## NL8010

The message of a warning `--warn-portability` turns on contains:

```text
…follows the native NaN and signed-zero rules here, not JavaScript's
```

**Retired**: WP33's float Math.min/max/round row; they lower to compare-and-select (llvm.minimum/maximum on wasm) and a copysign now, which answer NaN and -0 as JavaScript does, so no site diverges (tests/cases/port_num_libm pins the quiet)

## NL8011

The message of a warning `--warn-portability` turns on contains:

```text
…prints a negative zero as 0 here, and Node's console prints -0
```

**Retired**: WP33's printed negative zero; the reference reading's console (runtime/nish.mjs) prints String(x), so -0 prints 0 there as it does natively and no site diverges (tests/cases/port_num_negzero pins the quiet)

## NL8012

The message of a warning `--warn-portability` turns on contains:

```text
…is never instantiated, and its body needs the checker's types to translate…
```

[`nl8012_generic_stub.ts`](https://github.com/amritk/nish/blob/main/tests/wordings/nl8012_generic_stub.ts) (compiled with `--emit-ts build/test/wordings/nl8012_generic_stub`):

```ts
// NL8012: a generic no instance reaches is not typed by the checker, and an
// `i64` in its body is a `bigint` under Node, so `--emit-ts` writes it with a
// body that throws and says so.
const wide = <T>(xs: T[]): i64 => {
  return toI64(xs.length) + 1
}

export const main = (): number => 0
```

```text
`wide` is never instantiated, and its body needs the checker's types to translate: --emit-ts writes it as a stub that throws
```
